collectionNamesFilter.description:
When provided, the {@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfosByName} and
{@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfosByName} APIs will apply an additional filter by
the collections names.

collectionLocationFilter.description: When provided, filter the returned sourceCollections based on its {@link SourceCollectionUi#location}

inferAndCompareRemoteAndLocalSchema.description:
Whether we should infer and compare the local and remote collection schema in
{@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfosByName} and
{@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfosByName} APIs. This has a performance impact
because of the remote collection source inference

inferForeignKeyRelationships.description: Whether we should infer foreign key relationships on sql source collections.

retrieveAllRecursiveFields.description: Whether we should recursively retrieve all fieldTypes from mixins.

title:
Source collection spec used in {@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfosByName} and
{@link SourceSystemManager#sourceSystemRemoteAndLocalCollectionsInfos} to filter and project the results of those APIs
name: SourceCollectionUiSpec
